'''Valk Beroya''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior and the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Jos Beroya]]. Valk and her husband were members of [[Clan Vizla]], and she wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] with blue and black markings. Shortly before the [[Battle of Rishi]] in the [[Galactic War]], a group of independent operatives came to the clan's enclave on [[Tracyn Island]] to speak with Vizla, and Jos and Valk fought the group as part of Vizla's "challenges." The pair were defeated, though not [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Blood" />

Later, Valk Beroya joined Shae Vizla in her siege of the Eternal Empire's droid factory on [[Darvannis]], leading her team inside the factory.

==Behind the scenes==
Jos and Valk Beroya appear as the second-to-last boss in "Blood Hunt," a Flashpoint added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.<ref name="Blood" />

"Beroya" is the Mandalorian word for "Bounty Hunter" in [[Mando'a]].
